remarks: Set on a beautifully landscaped cul-de-sac lot in Clarence’s established Loch Lea Estates, this four-bedroom traditional offers approximately 2,858 square feet of living space based on appraisal measurements and is located within the Williamsville School District. A dramatic two-story foyer introduces a freshly painted, neutral interior accented by updated railings and balusters. Rich Brazilian cherry hardwood floors connect the formal living room, inviting family room and private first-floor study, which features dedicated exterior access and offers excellent flexibility as a home office. The tray-ceiling dining room provides an elegant setting for gatherings. The spacious kitchen features abundant wood cabinetry, granite countertops, a new refrigerator and commercial-grade stainless steel exhaust hood. Upstairs are four generously proportioned bedrooms with vaulted ceilings, including an expansive primary suite with a walk-in closet and glamour bath. The finished basement extends the home’s versatility with newly installed luxury vinyl flooring and additional space for recreation, exercise, work or hobbies. Outside, mature landscaping surrounds a private backyard retreat centered around the inground saltwater pool. A new pool liner and pool pump were installed in 2024. Additional improvements include an architectural roof installed in 2014, updated pool electrical lines, newer interior lighting fixtures and prior replacement of the furnace induction and exhaust motors. Substantial living space, flexible rooms, a finished basement and a resort-like pool setting create a distinctive Clarence home in Loch Lea Estates. Showings commence on Friday 9/25 at 1pm
